helpIntro: Duke undergraduates in Trinity and Pratt use a 4.0 GPA scale. Enter Duke course credits and final grades to estimate semester, cumulative, projected, and target GPA.
helpNote: A+ and A are both 4.0; D and D- are both 1.0. Transfer grades are excluded. Repeat Impact is disabled because Duke repeat rules are not simple replacement; a passed retake after F needs manual review.
helpExample: A 1.0-credit A earns 4.0 grade points and a 1.0-credit B earns 3.0; together, 7.0 ÷ 2.0 = 3.5.

gradeExplanations.A+: A+ = 4.0 points per Duke course credit.
gradeExplanations.U: U is 0.0 in the undergraduate GPA table; it also has separate standing consequences.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is not a final GPA grade; update the row when a final grade posts.
gradeExplanations.X: Absent from final examination; temporary notation pending resolution.
gradeExplanations.Z: First half of a two-semester sequence; final grade is assigned later.
gradeExplanations.N: No grade submitted; excluded until resolved.
gradeExplanations.WA: Withdrawal from audited course; excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: Duke undergraduate course
specialTypes.note: Use for ordinary Trinity/Pratt Duke-credit coursework.

specialTypes.name: External transfer course
specialTypes.note: Transfer grades are not included in Duke GPA.

specialTypes.name: Retake after an original F
specialTypes.note: Duke policy gives special GPA treatment to a passed retake after F; do not use ordinary count-all math.

specialTypes.name: Graduate or professional school course/system
specialTypes.note: Graduate and professional schools use different grading systems or GPA rules.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is disabled. Enter an eligible D-range repeat as separate completed rows; select manual review for a retake after an F.
